en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘A drinker of the wine, do not marry to him when he proposes’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
If one who drinks wine proposes for marriage, it must not be accepted.’”
